question: We're developing a mineral eye shadow base and want to use titanium dioxide as the colorant. May we, and what restrictions, certification or labeling apply?
key_elements: Yes. 73.2575(b) lists titanium dioxide for coloring cosmetics generally, including cosmetics intended for use in the area of the eye, in amounts consistent with good manufacturing practice (no numeric cap). It must conform in identity and specifications to § 73.575(a)(1) and (b) ((a)). The additive and its color mixtures bear § 70.25 labeling ((c)). Batches are exempt from section 721(c) certification ((d)).
